learning: Round-2 mockup looked clean in screenshots, yet a Playwright getBoundingClientRect sweep over every button/a/select/input found 7 targets under 44px (footer links 17px tall, switch 32px, city-chip remove 32x32). Measure targets in the browser before claiming Rule 33 item. Also: Unsplash is bot-walled from this Mac; Wikimedia Commons API filtered to CC0/Public domain gives usable food placeholders, but screen them on a contact sheet (3 of 6 were amateur or carried a third-party logo).
